title: Asahina Mafuyu — Colorful Recollection〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's time...
I should log in soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki.
I just posted my rough draft to chat. Mind taking a look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<For our song's illustration.
It's finally done.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We were just about to look at it too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too. It's way easier to tell what you're trying to say compared to before!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (In terms of composition, both sketches are very similar, but this one just feels better overall.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It was a mess before, but her use of space for the subject and other objects seems much more correct now too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That includes you too, Yuki. Don't pull any punches, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It feels better over all, but you went overboard when it came to working in these motifs to represent the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Grr... I was really careful about that too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But I felt the same thing.
Maybe I should cut back on those a little.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<No, wait.
I actually kind of like it the way it is.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree that it's a bit all over the place, but each of these elements play an important role in this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd like it if we could make this work somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What if you made it easier to differentiate between the motifs for the first and second verses?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... Wait, hang on. That still ends up with me having to remove stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But to be honest, the chorus still doesn't feel complete to me, so I want to try adding a little more sound...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm thinking that it'd be nice to have a denser sound to go along with some sort of effect for the illustration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, it's gonna take more materials than usual, but what if we split your draft into three layers...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. We could have one for the motifs from the first verse and another for the second verse like Yuki said...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And have them all appear at once on the last layer!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, that might actually be pretty good.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Like when the main character from a manga goes to fight the final boss with their friends!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry, Amia, I don't really get it either.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <In any case, you should rethink how many of these motifs you include where...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <As it stands, it's too much to process.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I get it. You don't have to rub salt in my wounds!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But Yuki... Can we chat for a minute after this? I thought it might be easier if we talked about your lyrics and discussed how we're both going to make changes.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Alright, Enanan, Yuki, you two can take care of how to divide up this draft into three layers.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm good with that too!
Man, this is gonna be so amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Don't forget that we have to make a bunch of fixes first.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you're going to do them since it'll look better in the end, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hm? Hey, what's going on? Someone say something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, it's nothing. Why don't we get back to work now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's do it♪ See you two later, Enanan, Yuki♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hm...? Well, whatever...
Anyway, Yuki, you ready?>
